lexical_plain: Torbin

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Speak with Dead

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Corrupted invasion from the sewers

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: ## Next Beats : ## Loot ## Into the Sewer **Looking Ahead : **The players will be rewarded for asking for help with custom items.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Mossglade comes with the leftover items from all the covert ops groups already laying claims to literally every item in the building.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: They just so happen to be ideal for each PC.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: ## Recap: The group has decided the best course of action is to take the Wolf to Stormspire Academy and see if someone can help cast Speak with Dead so they can learn more about the plans Wolf had.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: But as soon as they step outside the disheveled Council Chambers they are stopped by guards who were alerted to the Rune alarms.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Luckily Thalia is there to explain the situation and set the guard on alert for anyone with oily eyes.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo, not wanting to carry an entire body, removes the Wolf's head to take to the academy.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: When they enter the street outside they find it busy with activity.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Suddenly one of the covert ops groups shines a light on the group, demanding we tell them if we carry any meat with us.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: After Bonogo and Baergrom dump out hundreds of pounds of meat on the street the guards are quick to jump into action.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: As the group continues on to the academy the tainted meat is burned up by one of the mages.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: The group arrives at the Stormspire Academy and finds it bustling with activity.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Wizards are busy making potions, crafting runes and working on wards.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: The group approaches the desk of a Half-Elf: Head Clerk Mossglade.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: With a huff of impatience she asks how she can help.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Professor Cinderbranch is very interested in the events that led to Wolf's head ending up with the group.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Before departing with Professor Cinderbranch, Mossglade also tells the group about the "study room", a place the group can use to rest and recharge.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: She also tells the group that Torbin is in the infirmary under Professor Tealeaf's care.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: So now the group must decide which to do first: visit the Necromancer to speak to Wolf, or head to the Infirmary to check on Torbin.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: The group decides to do both by splitting up.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna and Baergrom decide to go check on Torbin, while Karsemine, Bonogo, Stafl, and Caelynn meet with the Necromancer.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna and Baergrom discover that Tealeaf has been unable to help Torbin and has not been able to help work on potions.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: They decide to stay with Torbin while Tealeaf goes into the next room to work on potions.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: The rest of the group meet with the Necromancer.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: When shown the head of Wolf they become very interested in helping.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Instead of casting a spell they decide to perform a ritual.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: While they get the ritual set up the group meets in the "Study Room" for a magical short rest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: While taking this short rest Caelynn plays a wonderful song on her mother's pan flute.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: When the group meets up again outside the room they discover that a piece of meat from Caelynn's bag escaped and is now on the loose in the Academy.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Again the group decides it is best to split up and take care of two things at once.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Stafl and Bonogo will go meet the Necromancer for the ritual while Caelynn, Baergrom and Karsemine will hunt for the meat.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna will stay with Torbin.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Stafl and Bonogo enter a basement morgue and find the head of Wolf in the center and the ritual about to begin.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: As with all Speak with Dead spells they are granted 5 questions.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Stafl promised one question for the Necromancer, so that left them with 4.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: 1: Tell us what killed you.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: He nods towards Bonogo.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: 2: Where are the strongholds for the meat storage?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Hidden in the walls, the guardhouses and underground.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: 3: How many are working on this plot against the city?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Everyone operates in small groups so the number is not known, but Lira will finish the plot before she dies.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: 4: Where is the Shepherd?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Everywhere!

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: In all the minds of the people.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Fifth question asked by the Necromancer: What is the plan and how will we know when it is complete?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: There is no stopping it!

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: They are gathering now and will soon erupt as something new, led by the Shepherd.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: All will die and be consumed.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: You will know at the break of dawn as the Shepherd rises from below.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: After the ritual Professor Cinderbranch leaves the room, just as Draven closes and locks the door.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Suddenly one of the walls opens up and 2 Elite Guards enter with a large and disgusting Sewer Meat Monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: The disgusting monster moves to the center of the room and oozes goo in a 10 foot radius.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Draven begins to monologue about cooking and eating Stafl and Bonogo as he casts Fear on Bonogo.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Luckily Stafl helps and forces the spell to miss.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: One Elite Guard attacks Stafl and deals damage as well as poisoning him.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Stafl counters with a radiant burst and casts Sleep on Draven, who falls asleep.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo sneak attacks the sleeping necromancer and deals massive damage resulting in a killing blow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: With his bonus attack Bonogo then strikes out at Elite Guard 2, but misses.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: That guard then attacks and hits Bonogo, poisoning him as well.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Just as he is being poisoned, the Sewer Monster bites Bonogo, dealing more damage.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: The other guard makes two attacks against Stafl, who then decides to run for the door.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: As soon as he is outside the door he yells for help then casts Sleep on the remaining enemies.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo also runs for the door, but takes the opportunity to attack the sleeping guard, dealing massive damage and racking up another kill.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: After explaining to Cinderbranch what happened, the group finds the ritual room empty, a bad sign of what is to come.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 1/Session Recaps/Session 13 - The Meaty and the Dead.md
lexical_plain: With the help of the Mages the party can stock up on items before they head down the tunnel to see what awaits...
